A.title: A - Deep tilled loam
A.description: Heavy, irregular clods through corners; short broken cultivation on faces. No crosswise tractor comb.

B.title: B - Flowing cultivation
B.description: Irregularly spaced curved grooves follow the riding line through corners and lengthwise up jump faces.

C.title: C - Ridden loam
C.description: Broken wheel ruts through mixed loose loam, with churned shoulders and stronger shape cues at distance.
